summary: Lane B2 is a SOURCE-KIND ruling (T25) only — no anchors, no continue points, no type changes, so target rows 1-10 take neither an anchor nor an anchor_hostile entry. The finding: Alternative Architecture's source is the ANIME ITSELF. Episodes 1-8 are a broadcast re-edit of the four 2013-14 Arise theatrical parts (each split 前編/後編 and re-ordered into Tow Ubukata's original plan: #01-02 border:4, #03-04 border:1, #05-06 border:2, #07-08 border:3 — ja-WP's 各話リスト prints an explicit 「オリジナル版エピソード出典」 column saying so, and the official site says the same), and episodes 9-10 'PYROPHORIC CULT' are 完全新作エピソード — wholly new material written by Junichi Fujisaku that bridges into the 2015 film Ghost in the Shell: The New Movie. They adapt NOTHING. Arise itself is an original pre-Section-9 story by Ubukata about the 501 Organization; Shirow's 攻殻機動隊 manga is 11 chapters in 1 volume and contains none of it — en-WP calls Arise 'a re-imagining of the 1989-91 manga', ja-WP calls it 「第4の攻殻」, a fourth branch alongside the manga, the Oshii films and S.A.C. AniList agrees: AA (21056) is source OTHER with NO adaptation edge, related only ALTERNATIVE to the four Arise films and SEQUEL to The New Movie, while Shirow's manga node (31023) draws ADAPTATION edges to the 1995 film, S.A.C., Innocence and the 2026 TV — and to no Arise entry at all. Recommendation: SOURCE_TYPE_OVERRIDES → 'original' (unit none, hasSource false, no tail badge, never anchorable).

structure.notes:
WHAT AA IS. 『攻殻機動隊ARISE ALTERNATIVE ARCHITECTURE』, TOKYO MX et al., 2015-04-05 → 2015-06-14, 10 episodes. The official site's INTRODUCTION states it exactly: 「2013年6月より順次劇場上映された『攻殻機動隊ARISE』シリーズ全4話を、それぞれ前後編に再編集、さらに映画『攻殻機動隊 新劇場版』に繋がる完全新作エピソード２話を加え、TVシリーズ…として放送」 and 「放送話数順は、シリーズ構成の冲方丁による初期案に基づいたエピソードの流れに再構成される」 (kokaku-a.jp/tv/introduction.html, live). en-WP: 'a recompilation of the four original parts of the OVA in a television format… The AAA broadcast included two original episodes (later released as the fifth OVA) that help tie Ghost in the Shell: Arise with its 2015 animated film sequel Ghost in the Shell: The New Movie.'

ROW-BY-ROW PROVENANCE (ja-WP 各話リスト（ARISE AA）, column 「オリジナル版エピソード出典」): #01 Ghost Stands Alone 前編 / #02 後編 → border:4; #03 Ghost Pain 前編 / #04 後編 → border:1; #05 Ghost Whispers 前編 / #06 後編 → border:2; #07 Ghost Tears 前編 / #08 後編 → border:3. Separate 新作エピソード table: #09 PYROPHORIC CULT 前編 and #10 後編, 脚本 藤咲淳一, 絵コンテ・演出 橘正紀. This matches our 10 stored rows and their titles exactly, in our order. en-WP's AA infobox splits the writing credit the same way: Tow Ubukata (1-8), Junichi Fujisaku (9-10).

WHAT THE TWO NEW EPISODES ADAPT: nothing. 完全新作 = wholly new; they were made for the broadcast and released afterwards as the fifth Arise OVA (BD/DVD 2015-08-26), and their function is to lead into 新劇場版 (2015-06-20). ja-WP places them in the Arise chronology at 2029年1月, after border:4's 2028年12月. There is no manga, novel or game unit behind them.

WHY NOT SHIROW'S MANGA. (a) Content: Arise's subject is 公安9課設立前 — the members before Section 9 exists, and Motoko's time in the 陸軍501機関 (ja-WP 概要). Shirow's 攻殻機動隊 (AniList 31023) is 11 chapters / 1 volume and begins with Section 9 already operating; nothing in Arise corresponds to a chapter of it. en-WP's lead calls Arise 'a re-imagining of the 1989-91 manga', not an adaptation. ja-WP calls it 「第4の攻殻」, the fourth GitS, listed as a peer of the manga, the Oshii films and S.A.C. (b) The credit: 原作＝士郎正宗 on Arise is a franchise credit — the official site frames it as 「士郎正宗の原作誕生から25年…」 (25 years since the original's birth) and the copyright reads ©士郎正宗・Production I.G／講談社・「攻殻機動隊ARISE」製作委員会. Per the standing warning that a blanket credit is not an adoption or adaptation basis, this credit carries the world and characters, not the events. (c) AniList's own graph: 31023 lists ADAPTATION → 43 (1995 film), 467 (S.A.C.), 468 (Innocence), 177699 (2026 TV) — and NOTHING in the Arise family. AA (21056) has source OTHER and zero ADAPTATION edges; its relations are ALTERNATIVE → 17187 / 19191 / 19193 / 19195 (the four borders) and SEQUEL → 21057 (The New Movie). The `source: MANGA` printed on the four Arise FILMS is an unsupported franchise inference — those nodes' only manga edge is described next.

THE ONE MANGA IN ARISE'S GRAPH, AND WHY IT IS NOT A SOURCE. 攻殻機動隊ARISE〜眠らない眼の男 Sleepless Eye〜 (AniList 78321, 42 chapters / 7 volumes, Monthly Young Magazine 2013-03-13 → 2016-06-20, story Junichi Fujisaku, art Takumi Ōyama). AniList edges it ADAPTATION *of* border:1 (17187) — i.e. it is a comicalization of the Arise project (the T21 class: the manga adapts the anime), announced as such alongside the films (「コミカライズ版も3月スタート」, cited by en-WP). It is a Batou-focused parallel story; no AA episode adapts it, so it is not even a side_source candidate here. Its March 2013 start date (three months BEFORE border:1's June 2013 release) is a date trap — earlier serialisation does not make it a source when it is announced and credited as the project's comicalization.

INSTRUMENT. Under an 'original' ruling: unit = none, hasSource = false, hasInstrument = false, tailBadge = null, seriesLabel 'studio original'. No chapter space exists in which any of the 10 rows could be positioned, so no anchor will ever be honest here — that is a property of the kind, not an A44 row ruling.

flags_for_sean: RECOMMENDATION (T25): SOURCE_TYPE_OVERRIDES['ghost-in-the-shell-arise-alternative-architecture'] = 'original'. Registered kind, no registry change needed ({ value: 'original', noun: 'anime', unit: 'none', tailBadge: null, seriesLabel: 'studio original', aflAnimeCanon: 'canon' }). Shape matches the outlaw-star precedent in OVERRIDE_ENTRIES: AniList's source field is a franchise inference, the anime IS its own source, and the manga in the graph is a sibling/derivative telling rather than the work being adapted.

TYPE CONSEQUENCE — PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING (I did not emit type_corrections; this lane forbids them). 'original' has aflAnimeCanon = 'canon' (T27: AFL's 'canon to the anime, not from the manga' means canon on a studio original). Our stored rows 9-10 (PYROPHORIC CULT) are typed FILLER and AFL says filler. Under an 'original' ruling those two rows adhere to the source (the anime itself) as completely as rows 1-8 do — they are new episodes of the work, written by the project's own writer, released as the fifth Arise OVA, and load-bearing for the sequel film. If the override is applied, 9-10 should become canon in the same motion, or the ruling and the rows will contradict each other and trip afl_anime_canon_unruled / ruling_violation. Evidence for the retype is in structure.notes (ja-WP 新作エピソード table; official site INTRODUCTION; en-WP AA infobox writer split).

ALTERNATIVE considered and rejected: 'manga' (holding that 原作：士郎正宗 is a source claim). Rejected on three counts: Shirow's manga is 11 chapters in one volume and Arise adapts none of them; en-WP calls Arise a 're-imagining' and ja-WP a parallel 「第4の攻殻」; and AniList's own manga node draws adaptation edges to the 1995 film, S.A.C., Innocence and the 2026 TV but to no Arise entry. Ruling 'manga' would switch on hasInstrument and a 'manga only' tail badge for 10 episodes that can never carry a position — exactly the fabricated-position failure P6/A1 exist to prevent.

ALTERNATIVE considered and rejected: treating the four Arise OVA films as the 'source' work. Our registry has no kind for 'this anime adapts another anime' — 'original' is the value that says 'the anime IS the source', and that is the right answer for a re-cut. The re-cut relationship is an IDENTITY/structure fact, not a source-kind fact: AA is Production I.G's own re-edit of its own films, aired as one 10-episode TV series, which is how our 10 rows are shaped. Related open question for an I-family pass, NOT answered here: our catalog appears to hold only AA (10 rows) and not the four Arise films as a separate series — if the films are ever added, the two entries need an explicit relation so AA is not read as a duplicate.

CONSISTENCY CHECK Sean may want to run: ghost-in-the-shell-stand-alone-complex is a sibling case with the SAME 原作：士郎正宗 credit but a DIFFERENT AniList shape — Shirow's manga 31023 does carry ADAPTATION → 467 (S.A.C.), so S.A.C. derives 'manga' honestly from the pipeline while AA cannot. If Sean judges S.A.C. to be the same class of original-story branch, that is a separate T25 ruling on a separate series with its own evidence; nothing here should be applied to it by analogy.
